h:
嘿伙计们，怎么样？几个月后我带着新帖子回来了（暂时）。

我一直在使用 Anima 模型测试 ComfyUI，我不得不说我喜欢该模型和使用 ComfyUI 所呈现的图像效果。因此，利用我对这个稳定扩散界面知之甚少的信息，我创建了一个相当简单的工作流程，非常适合我生成高质量的图像。

正如我之前提到的，这个工作流程非常简单，这是因为它是为像我这样没有太多使用 ComfyUI 并发现所有这些节点和连接令人难以承受的人而设计的。这个简单的工作流程可以帮助在 ComfyUI 中生成图像，感觉不像中世纪的十字军东征（笑）。

为了使工作流程以最佳方式工作，您需要安装 ComfyUI 自定义节点，因为工作流程的某些组件需要它们：

https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack
https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack
https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use

我希望这个资源对您和我一样有用。

对于该工作流程的1.5版本，如果您想使用签名应用功能，您应该安装下面的这个自定义节点。

https://github.com/vergil-sparda0701/comfyui-apply-signature

o.en:
Hey guys, how's it going? I'm back (for now) with a new post after months.

I've been testing ComfyUI with the Anima models, and I have to say I love how the images turn out with that model and using ComfyUI. So, using what little I know about this Stable Diffusion interface, I created a fairly simple workflow that works quite well for me to generate high-quality images.

This workflow, as I mentioned before, is very simple, and that's because it's designed for people like me who haven't used ComfyUI much and find all those nodes and connections overwhelming. This simple workflow could help make generating images in ComfyUI feel less like a medieval crusade (laughs).

To make the workflow work optimally, you'll need to install the ComfyUI custom nodes, as some components of the workflow require them:

https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack
https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack
https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use

I hope this resource is as useful to you as it was to me.

For the 1.5 version of this workflow, you should install this custom node below if you want to use the signature apply function.

https://github.com/vergil-sparda0701/comfyui-apply-signature
